_meta: PcDetailCharaDisplaySetting per-character. Five Vector2 fields (positionDetailIllust, scaleDetailIllust, positionFullDetailIllust, scaleFullDetailIllust, presentEffectOffsetPosition) extracted from the ScriptableObject .asset referenced by MasterPcMaterial.pc_detail_setting_path. CharacterAppear's image2d uses positionFullDetailIllust + scaleFullDetailIllust (via XIUICharacterDisplay.Set2DTransform).
